title: sorbus alnifolia var. lobulata
intro: Sorbus alnifolia var. lobulata, commonly known as Korean Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia, characterized by its showy white flowers and red berries. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus alnifolia var. lobulata include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant activities, which may help reduce fever, relieve pain, and promote mucus secretion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
